webster.text: Piety in principle, is a compound of veneration or reverence of the Supreme Being and love of his character, or veneration accompanied with love; and piety in practice, is the exercise of these affections in obedience to his will and devotion to his service.

example.quote: Can their piety alone be entrusted with the care of public worship?
example.cite: James Madison, Memorial and Remonstrance Against Religious Assessments, c. June 20, 1785
